result.title: ThunderSyncRL: Lossless Acceleration of Agentic Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Language models are moving beyond generating answers to pursuing long-horizon goals in interactive environments. Post-training these agents requires long, heterogeneous trajectories, and synchronous systems leave learner engines idle until rollout and verification finish. To squeeze out these pipeline bubbles, asynchronous training overlaps rollout and learning across updates, but comes at the cost of policy staleness. We introduce ThunderSyncRL, which starts gradient computation as soon as all required inputs are fixed, without policy staleness. For group relative policy optimization (GRPO), ThunderSyncRL computes each trajectory's score gradient as soon as the reward for that trajectory arrives, without waiting for the group. For on-policy distillation (OPD), it computes gradients for each completed agentic turn's teacher-scored actions while tool calls run in the sandbox. We prove that gradient streaming produces the same GRPO and OPD updates as batch-synchronous training, without changing either objective. On SWE-bench Verified and Terminal Bench 4.0, we train models to the same performance up to $1.9 \times$ faster than synchronous training. With zero policy staleness, ThunderSyncRL also outperforms asynchronous training at a fixed budget by up to $2.47$ percentage points.

AI.brief_summary: ThunderSyncRL 提出在 GRPO 与 on-policy 蒸馏中一旦单条轨迹的奖励或教师评分可用就立即计算梯度，从而在无策略陈旧性的前提下把推理与学习流水线重叠，在 SWE-bench Verified 与 Terminal Bench 上实现最高约 1.9 倍加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作面向长程 agentic rollout 的训练流水线效率与贡献分配时序，可能为 LVR 中轨迹级监督与停止决策的训练成本提供参考，但其核心是训练调度而非 latent 推理状态生成，需核查是否触及推理期状态更新。
